paper_title: Searching for dark matter with an unequal delay interferometer
coupling_convention: d_e, dimensionless dilatonic coupling to the electromagnetic field (alpha variation), 95% CL upper limit as plotted (galactic DM model, top-left panel of Fig. 3)
notes: DAMNED (DArk Matter from Non-Equal Delays) unequal-delay fibre interferometer at Paris Observatory. New 95% CL upper limits on scalar DM couplings d_e (fine-structure constant) and d_me (electron mass) over masses 4.1e-11 to 8.3e-10 eV (10-200 kHz), assuming standard galactic halo density 0.4 GeV/cm^3, with stochastic-field marginalization (Centers et al. factor included). The paper constrains BOTH d_e (ScalarPhoton) and d_me (ScalarElectron) in a maximum-reach approach; ScalarPhoton chosen per pre-analysis hint. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: no numerical table is provided in the text; the limits appear only in Fig. 3 which is not machine-readable here.
